bounds: One proof-version-1 session spanning /ws deferred credits import, durable Hello claim, three deferred opening imports, revocation fence and one joined retirement. A stopped opening settles at import delivery before it starts a revocation subscription. The opening can exit to a separately unmodeled provider/admission region only before stop. Successful storage transactions and acknowledgement settle together.
limitations: One minted proof-version-1 session, one valid authenticated Hello, one public socket, one opening claim, one retirement attempt and successful or failed import/storage completion. Claim identity is one fixed symbolic owner; generations range from zero through two.

The model ends the checked acquisition region when an unretired opening passes its revocation fence. Quota, money/admission, provider creation, active PCM/TTS controls, renewal, provider cleanup and terminal financial evidence remain separate obligations.

Storage transitions combine commit and acknowledgement in this finite outcome projection. Applied-but-unacknowledged storage, object eviction/restart, repeated retirement attempts, expiry, multiple sockets and concurrent initialization are outside it.

The Workerd fixture wraps delivery after actual deferred imports resolve at the upgrade, opening and close source awaits. Coordinator guards and generation/proof logic run as written; native sockets and SQLite Durable Object storage remain real. Existing controlled provider, quota and DB boundaries are retained; this is not live provider or PostgreSQL billing proof.

Progress assumes each admitted import, fence operation and storage operation settles, plus fair local continuations. Failure may return an unconfirmed outcome. No eventual successful retirement or wall-clock bound is promised.
The proof comparison now >= initializedAt is valid in this instance. Clock reversals, expiration during loading and clock-driven retry deadlines require their separate time projection.

assumptions: No fairness. Stop is local before its DB import; an upgrade awaiting the credits import cannot allocate afterward.
No fairness. A claimed opening resumed after stop cannot leave the checked fence region for provider admission.
No fairness. This single capability cannot claim again after committed retirement.
CompletionFairness weakly fairly settles admitted dependency imports, the revocation fence, storage outcomes and local join continuation. Success and failure are both outcomes.
The checked region assumes native pending-socket closure succeeds and the opening has not passed the revocation fence before stop.
No fairness. Dependency delivery or a storage operation may stutter forever.
